info.title: HelpDesk API
info.description: Register/login at /api/auth. Use the accessToken in Authorize. Identity tokens are opaque, not JWT. Mutations require the latest ticket version.

get.summary: List own tickets, or all tickets for Support. Stable sorting and pagination.

post.summary: Create a ticket owned by the current user.

get.summary: Get one visible ticket. Other users' tickets return 404.

put.summary: Edit title, description and priority. Supply the current version.

post.summary: Support: assign an open ticket to yourself.
Assigned Support agent: close a ticket in progress.
Owner or Support: reopen a closed ticket and clear assignment.

get.summary: Read comments after checking ticket access.

post.summary: Add a comment; returns the ticket with its new version. Closed tickets are read-only.

Bearer.description: Paste accessToken only (without the Bearer prefix).
